hypothesis: Use deterministic root sequential halving to spend the same 64 visits comparing promising actions, keeping ordinary PUCT below the root and pending-aware batching. No Gumbel noise at evaluation. This is an independent implementation inspired by the paper, not a full Gumbel AlphaZero implementation.
selection: Highest development score, tie prefers 8. Single global configuration; no board-specific selection.
strengthGate: Paired 95% bootstrap lower bound >0.5; each board >=12/32; no caps/illegal moves.
speedGate: Same 18 fixed roots CPU/WASM and WebGPU; aggregate P95 <=1.05 baseline, every board <=1.10. Default 64 visits and same model.
budget: The first finite collect budget declares the root planning budget. Unlimited/incremental collection remains PUCT. Halving stage budgets align to neural batches; final remainder is shared among finalists.
policy: Finite-budget halving reports a normalized improved policy over remaining root candidates; raw visit diagnostics remain available. Exact wins/refutations take priority.
